user.title: Better Thermostat Presets
user.description: The integration is added with defaults. Change naming and preset exclusions later from the integration's Configure page.

data_description.excluded_presets: Comma-separated preset names that should not appear as options.
data_description.entity_id_suffix: Suffix appended to the generated entity ID.
data_description.name_mode: Choose only one mode: Prefix appends a fixed suffix, Regex rewrites the name using a pattern.
data_description.name_suffix: Fixed text appended to the thermostat name, for example: Heizpreset.
data_description.name_pattern: Regex syntax, for example ^(.+)$ or .*\((.+)\).* . The pattern is applied to the original name.
data_description.name_replacement: Replacement text. You can use backreferences such as \1 or \g<0>.
